46f217c02a484ae652c43d874ab751e32bb2eaff.summary: Wiz reports on JINX-0164, a financially motivated actor active since at least mid-2025 that targets cryptocurrency-industry developers with fake recruiter and meeting lures. A two-week intrusion used a macOS infostealer, AUDIOFIX, to steal credentials, then injected it into internal code repositories. A trojanized npm SDK on April 7, 2026 delivered a second backdoor, MINIRAT. Wiz does not link the group to a sponsor. Similarities to North Korean groups are noted but not confirmed.

hedges: Wiz's research does not yet provide enough evidence to link this group to a sponsor.
JINX-0164 appears to be motivated by financial gain.
Similarities to North Korean groups are described as suggesting some association; no infrastructure overlap has been identified.
Cryptocurrency wallet theft is described as the most likely objective; a supply-chain attack is described as another potential objective.
Some actor-controlled infrastructure suggests the group may target Windows machines as well; this is not confirmed.
The GitHub source code was not modified, suggesting the attackers only had access to npm credentials.
At this time only the primary C2 domain has been identified as resolving.
The start in mid-2025 is described as possible: 'possibly as early as mid-2025'.
